annotations.title: Add a rank tracker chart note

description: Adds a chart note to a rank tracker's own timeline. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Config-level, not per-keyword or per-device. A config can hold at most 100 notes.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

date.description: UTC day the note applies to, YYYY-MM-DD.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: add_rank_annotation
